description: Replying to @Gabrielle🌸 chest out , chin up! Reflection and accountability is key! #careeradvice #lifebydesign #30something #bigsisteradvice
transcript: When it comes to self-control and emotion management, the first thought process for me is always chest out, chin up. And within that, that allows me the confidence to hold myself accountable, no matter what the situation is. I am going to get myself to the other side and as I get to the other side, I've learned to see things for what they are and clearly visualize what reality is and I can clearly see reality when I go back and I reflect. Reflection is the key and when I look at the things that trigger me or the environments that trigger me, I've learned how to occupy those spaces better.
